newsitem.title: UK: Meconic up on favourable press comment.
newsitem.headline: Meconic up on favourable press comment.

text.p: Shares in UK chemical maker Meconic Plc advanced to another record following a favourable press comment over the weekend, dealers said.
By 1213 GMT, the shares climbed 9p to 362-1/2, up 81 percent from a year ago and up 169 percent since the company's June 1995 float.
The Independent on Sunday newspaper said the stock looked good value given the prospects for strong growth in the company's core and newly-acquired businesses.

The paper said Meconic had a strong position as the world's leading manufacturer of opiates, which are made into pain killers. Profits also stand to benefit from Meconic's newly acquired Phoenix Chemicals, which uses engineering and computer technology to perform chemical experiments.
